Reconsider moving Priddis-area Foothills/Kananaskis residents from Banff-Kananaskis into Banff-Jasper.

quote: For these reasons, Lesser Slave Lake should remain a focal point for governance as well, and should not be split into two constituencies.
note: Also p. 20: concerns with 'the new constituency called Mackenzie, and the radical breaking up of the existing Lesser Slave Lake Constituency'; praises current LSL boundaries.

asks: Add the new Calgary seat in south Calgary rather than downtown, support hybrid ridings, and allow flexible population variances.
Keep rural areas such as Bearspaw with rural communities and do not combine them with Calgary.
Add another all-Edmonton urban seat without hybrid ridings.
Restore Edmonton-Riverview, keep Beaumont and Medicine Hat whole, and avoid Edmonton-West-Enoch style hybrids.
Leave Lethbridge as it is.

note: Entire message is four words; header: current and proposed division Lethbridge-West. 'As is' = two city-only districts (current and interim).

asks: Retain the Municipality of Jasper in West Yellowhead rather than Banff-Jasper.
Put any new Calgary seat in south Calgary, expand hybrid ridings around Calgary and Edmonton, and apply population parity flexibly.
Keep Taber-Warner as currently drawn, with Taber and Coaldale together, rather than Cardston-Taber-Warner.

note: Lethbridge named only as the far end of Taber's Highway 3 corridor; no request about joining Taber or Coaldale to part of the city (rule 8).

asks: Put any new Calgary seat in south Calgary, expand hybrid ridings around Calgary and Edmonton, and apply population parity flexibly.
Keep Conrich in a Calgary-based electoral district.

note: Header names '57 - Chestermere-Strathmore' as the division written about, but the message concerns only Conrich staying in a Calgary riding; says nothing about Chestermere itself.

asks: Move Springbank out of the proposed Cochrane-Springbank riding into Calgary-Bow and move Bowness and Montgomery to a central Calgary district.

quote: The decision to group Springbank into a "Cochrane-Springbank" riding— stretching 60 kilometers north to the Hamlet of Madden—ignores the massive residential growth happening right here in West Calgary.
note: Objects to Springbank being with Cochrane and wants Springbank in Calgary-Bow; says nothing about where Cochrane itself should go, so no want or rejection coded for Cochrane (rule 17). A reader could treat it as a partial rejection of C1.

asks: Keep Edmonton-Riverview within its current boundaries and add another Edmonton (and Calgary) seat.
Keep Jasper in the Yellowhead riding rather than a Banff-Bow Valley riding.
Keep the current number of Central Alberta ridings, keep Red Deer County west of Highway 2 out of the Innisfail riding, and add Trochu to it.

note: Red Deer named only as the centre the riding's towns look toward; Trochu with Innisfail does not touch this element (codebook R note).

quote: the town of Trochu has strong connections to my constituency – that is where multi-generational farm families in the core of my riding buy their farm equipment
note: Asks that Trochu (in the prairie riding on current, interim and both final maps) join Sylvan Lake-Innisfail; neither O1 nor O2 and the Olds riding is not named, so coded as a mention only (rule 17). Could be O9.

quote: I would respectfully ask you to reconsider a hybrid model that incorporates part of Lethbridge with communities to the East / South East down the Agri Food Corridor that extends down Highway 3.
note: Reacting to interim Cardston-Taber-Warner. Asks for one Lethbridge-Highway 3 hybrid (resembles the minority's Lethbridge-Taber-Warner) but says nothing of dividing the city four ways or of the rest of the city, so L3 not L2 (rule 7).

asks: Keep urban and rural ridings separate and add another Edmonton riding.

quote: Retain a distinct Lesser Slave Lake electoral division in the final boundary plan.
